raw_response:
I need to disable the Quick Filter (which is hiding the one unread “Important” message) so it shows up in the list:

```python
import pyautogui, time

# wait for UI to settle

# toggle-button at (960,112) size (125×31) → center ≈ (1023,128)
pyautogui.moveTo(1023, 128, duration=0.2)
pyautogui.click()
```
